LanguageData.VV_Message_EverflowerEnshrined: The everflower has been enshrined on the altar.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EverflowerAltarRequiresLevel: Only an everflower of attunement level {LEVEL} or higher can be enshrined on the altar.
LanguageData.VV_Message_AnchorEverflowerLeftAltar: The altar is gone, and the everflower has teleported off it.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_AltarOnlyEverflowerCenter: Only an everflower can be enshrined at the center of the altar.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_AltarCenterOccupied: An everflower is already enshrined on this altar.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_AltarOnePerMap: Only one everflower altar can be built on each map.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_AltarBlockedByArcanePlant: Cannot build over an arcane plant.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_AltarNotHomeMap: An everflower altar can only be built in a settlement.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_AltarOnSubstructure: An everflower altar cannot be built on a gravship.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_AltarUnderConstruction: Cannot place on an everflower altar under construction.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_AltarHasEnshrinedEverflowe: Cannot deconstruct while the everflower is blooming or a ritual is underway
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerAttunementLevel5Prea: Resonating with the altar's mana circuits, the everflower has entered its fifth bloom.\n\nThe everflower's mana output grows stronger, everflower reverberation is sustained on adult non-royal vivis in the colony, and the resonator's everflower resonance deepens to stage V.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerAttunementLevel6Prea: With its sixth bloom, the everflower has come into full bloom. The weight of the bond, once borne by the resonator alone, has begun to flow into the flower as well.\n\nThe resonator's everflower resonance deepens to stage VI, removing the fatigue and movement penalties from bound fairy vivis, and adult vivis in the colony age much more slowly.
LanguageData.VV_Command_ReserveTeleportEverflowerAlta: Teleports an everflower of attunement level {LEVEL} or higher onto the altar to enshrine it.
